title: Positive degree from a nonzero slice
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $f:\mathbb{F}_2^{n+1}\to\mathbb{F}_2$. Suppose the slice of $f$ with first coordinate $0$ is identically zero, while its slice with first coordinate $1$ is not identically zero. If the algebraic degree of $f$ is at most $k$, then $0<k$.
hypotheses_covered: the first-coordinate-$0$ slice is identically zero
the algebraic degree of $f$ is at most $k$
